only_new_parameter: L: adverse PRICE fraction from actual entry fill, common long/short
entry_rule: original frozen slope sign at previous close; no cooldown; after any stop, earliest reentry is next candle open using previous close signal
open_event_priority: resting stop gap first; if gap stop, no reentry at that same open; otherwise normal scheduled sign exit then new entry; new entry stop active immediately
intrabar_rule: after open events, adverse high/low touch fills at fixed stop then adverse slippage; no same-candle reentry
intrabar_time_policy: unknown within 15min; time columns contain bar-open label plus explicit precision; holding lower and upper bounds both saved
gap_rule: open crosses or equals resting stop: raw fill=open, then adverse slippage; never fill a better stop price
no_stop_control_required: all original S0 trades, executions, equity, costs and drawdowns match serialized originals before any L run
top_winners: original N64 top10 positive CLOSED net trades fixed once; actual early stops, episode PnL after all reentries, and original-entry isolated touch audit separately reported
selection: all seven results for human review; no automatic best L or frozen candidate
